senses.gloss: (euphem., cmp. גּוּף ch.) to have illegitimate intercourse; (also as act. v.) to seduce.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 36:20">Targ. Job XXXVI, 20</cite> <he>תגור</he> Ms. (ed. <he>תְגַיֵּר</he>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 20:10">Targ. Y. Lev. XX, 10</cite> (O. <cite ref="C00456"><he>גוף</he></cite>); a. e.—Part. <cite ref="C00805"><he>גָּיֵר</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00809"><he>גָּיְרָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3">Lev. R. s. 3</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:6">Koh. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>ג׳ בחזורין</he> Ar. (ed. <he>גָּיְפָא</he>), v. <cite ref="C00456"><he>גּוּף</he></cite> ch.—

Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ הוה ליה ההיא ברתא דשמה גירא וכ׳ he (the emperor) had a daughter whose name was Gira (Ar. גילא), and who did wrong (was seduced); he sent to him (Rabbi) גרגירא (Ar. גרגילא) a gargira (rocket, play on גירא).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 26:20">Targ. Job XXVI, 20</cite>, v. supra.
